question: Do the 002 period and hour concentrations survive train-only threshold changes, and which event severities and dates account for the difference?
previous_evidence: 002: 139/4108 vs 85/1218 onsets and 59/139 vs 57/85 multi-hour episodes; no severity or contribution decomposition
thresholds: Jan-Jun peak percentiles .90, .95, .975; retain .95=182 baseline, do not choose by Jul-Aug outcomes
scope: Jan-Aug valid timestamps, zeros retained, exact previous/next hour; gaps never bridged; report censoring and cross-period events
metrics: high and onset rates; 08/13/other onset rate; event maximum/duration/excess-value sum; daily/weekly concentration; recurrence gaps; duration by start hour; mean-vs-max daily rank sensitivity
decision: Keep only conclusions consistent across fixed thresholds. Excess-value sums are descriptive, not energy or money. Connect concentrated contributors to period composition/influence checks.
